title: Service agreement
description: An agreement under which a service provider (a consultant, agency or freelancer) agrees to do work for a client for a fee. Covers scope, fees, term, ownership of the work, confidentiality, liability and disputes.

fields.label: Fees and basis (for example fixed fee, monthly retainer, hourly)
fields.hint: Include the amount, for example: fixed fee of 150000.

fields.label: When and how the provider is paid (optional)
Duration of the agreement (for example 6 months)
Notice period for ending early, in days (optional)
Who owns the finished work
options: The provider keeps ownership and licenses the client

fields.label: Limit on the provider's liability (optional)
fields.hint: For example: the fees paid in the last 6 months.

relies_on.why: What makes an agreement a contract.
Compensation for breach where a sum is named in the contract.

conditional_relies_on.why: What an arbitration agreement is and that it must be in writing.

search_queries: agreement in restraint of trade void
compensation for breach of contract penalty stipulated

sections.title: Title, date and parties
sections.instruction: Write the opening 'This Service Agreement is made on [effective date]' between the client and the service provider with addresses.

sections.title: Services
sections.instruction: Write the services clause from the description given, as numbered sub-clauses; add that the provider will perform them with reasonable skill and care and in line with timelines agreed in writing. Do not add deliverables or deadlines that were not given.

sections.title: Fees and payment
sections.instruction: State the fees and basis exactly as given (figures and words where an amount was given), the payment terms if given (otherwise use the placeholder [PAYMENT SCHEDULE]), that invoices are in writing, that taxes such as GST are payable as applicable by law (without stating a rate), and expenses only if agreed in writing.

sections.title: Term and termination
sections.instruction: State the duration as given, how either party may end the agreement early (the notice period given, otherwise [NOTICE PERIOD IN DAYS]), ending for material breach not remedied within a placeholder period [CURE PERIOD], and what happens to fees earned up to the end.

sections.title: Ownership of the work
sections.instruction: Write the clause matching the choice given: either the client owns the deliverables on payment, or the provider keeps ownership and grants the client a licence to use them; also pre-existing materials stay with their owner.

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.instruction: Write a concise confidentiality clause: each party keeps the other's confidential information secret, uses it only for this agreement, with the usual exclusions (public, already known, lawfully received, independently developed), surviving the end of the agreement for a period placeholder [CONFIDENTIALITY PERIOD].

sections.title: Liability
sections.instruction: State the liability limit if one was given, exactly as given; if none was given, write only that liability is as the law provides and add the placeholder [LIABILITY LIMIT, IF ANY]. Mention the retrieved compensation provision only in the way the retrieved text describes it, and do not state any penalty sum that was not given.

sections.title: Governing law and disputes
sections.instruction: State that Indian law governs. If arbitration was chosen, write an arbitration clause in writing with the seat at the city given and a placeholder [NUMBER OF ARBITRATORS], referring to the retrieved arbitration provision only as its text supports; if courts were chosen, give the courts at the city jurisdiction.

sections.title: General terms
sections.instruction: Number short clauses: independent contractor (no employment), entire agreement, amendment in writing, no assignment without consent, notices in writing to the addresses above, severability.

sections.title: Signatures
sections.fixed:
IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties have signed this Agreement on the date first written above.

For {{client_name}} (Client)

________________________
Name: {{client_name}}
Date:

For {{provider_name}} (Service Provider)

________________________
Name: {{provider_name}}
Date:

reminders.text: Check the stamp duty and any stamping requirement for an agreement of this kind in the state where it is signed. Do not rely on a figure that is not from the state's current rules.
Check GST and income-tax (TDS) treatment of the fees with an accountant; the agreement states only that taxes are payable as the law requires.
Check the services description and timelines are specific enough that both sides would agree on whether the work was done.
Have the agreement reviewed by a qualified lawyer before it is signed.
